ios.desc:
Find your way with Mapy.com’s maps no matter where you are: hiking on small forest paths, biking in mountains and even without a signal.

Mapy.com is an outdoor route planner with tracker and navigation that works also offline with GPS. New features include peak recognition or location sharing that should help you enjoy your trail to the max.

-	Maps of the whole world: outdoor, aerial, winter
-	Local POIs, tips for trips and category search
-	Easy to use route planner with many planning options
-	Hiking, mtb or road bike supported
-	Outdoor step-by-step navigation with GPS
-	Distance tracker for many outdoor activities
-	Location sharing with friend or family

Route planner

-	A to B or round route planning
-	Many options for hiking or biking
-	Route information: estimated time, distance, elevation

Choose your style and plan the route exactly to your needs, whatever activity you want to do. Mapy.com’s route planner has multiple options for both walking and biking – and when the snow falls, you can also plan with cross-country ski or skialp.

Display the information for your route and find out the distance, elevation, or time estimation. If you are an advanced user, you’ll appreciate the settings of your own speed or the slope shading that completes the elevation profile overview.

GPS Maps and navigation

-	Location on the map with GPS turned on
-	Step-by-step outdoor navigation

You always know where you are with Mapy.com. Your GPS location is displayed directly on the map, and you can find the way to your destination from there with navigation. You can also turn on the voice navigation available in 10 languages.

Offline maps

-	For places without connection
-	Saving data and battery
-	Download one region or whole countries

Device is offline? No problem, offline maps save the day. Small mountain paths or deep forest without connection, you will find the way. Just be sure to download the region before you go.

Tracker

-	Performance recording for many outdoor activities
-	Travelled distance, speed and time tracking

Track your trails and save your progress. Know your pace, travelled distance or elevation for each of your activities. Tracker helps you have overview of your adventures and can be used also on Apple Watch.

Location sharing

-	Location of your loved ones on the map

Know where your friends and family are: turn on the location sharing and display their portraits on the map. Always find each other when someone gets delayed by the nice view o

quotes.text:
> Many people don't realize why Google maps are so much better than anything out there.

Absolutely not true. I don't use Google Maps in Czech Republic at all as there is a solid local map provider[1] - (they offer whole world through OSM, so I use that on phone as well[2], but it's not that great). They lost some edge with Google going full-textured 3D few years back (actually the Czech map had it sooner, just not as useful). But other than that much cleaner rendering, equally good aerial or street view, better routing, POIs, richer layers ...

(edit: and two huge UX advantages over GM: no stupid random rotation - North is UP, and a very quick and precise zoom by holding control)

Anyway, I wouldn't be surprised if there were similar stories in other countries.

1. https://en.mapy.cz/

2. https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=cz.seznam.mapy or recently released as https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=cz.seznam.windymaps (haven't tried it)
Mapy.cz (https://apps.apple.com/ch/app/mapy-cz/id411411020?l=en) does collect some data (see App Privacy in the App Store), but is not linked to „your identity“.

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=cz.seznam.mapy

Bit focused on eastern Europe, but has a hiking mode with very good coverage of the official routes (not only in eastern Europe ;)). And everything is free, including offline maps. Terrific value for casual trips.

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.bergfex.tour

This one is not free (there is a free tier though) but seems to have more details in some areas, so the pro tier may be worth it if you hike a lot.

quotes.text:
I think mapy [1] is the best frontend I've seen for OSM.  Its search still isn't as good as Google Maps though.

They also have iOS [2] and Android [3] apps.  I can't speak for the iOS app, but the Android one lets you download offline maps in a very space efficient way, similar to Organic Maps.

1.  https://en.mapy.cz/zakladni?x=-2.2989613&y=53.1629710&z=8

2.  https://apps.apple.com/cz/app/mapy-cz-maps-navigation/id411411020

3.  https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=cz.seznam.mapy&hl=en_US
OSMand is powerful but the UI can ve overwhelming. Organic maps seem popular https://organicmaps.app/ but I prefer the style of Mapy.cz https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=cz.seznam.mapy
